cards.text: Jesus is leaving the temple and walking away. His disciples come up to Him to point out its buildings. Friend, that's me pulling a tray out of the oven: "Look at THIS one. No, no, look at THIS one!"

cards.question: The disciples are pointing out the temple buildings. What does Jesus tell them about those buildings?

answers.text: Not one stone will be left on another
Every stone will be covered in gold
Every stone will stand for all time

cards.text: Every stone. Thrown down. They point at the building, Jesus says it's coming DOWN, and I bet the rest of that walk got real quiet.

cards.question: Later, Jesus is sitting on the Mount of Olives, and the disciples come to Him privately. What do they ask Him?

answers.text: When it will happen and what the sign will be
Who will tear the temple down and how
Where they should go and who to bring

cards.text: They want a date. A day, a time, circled on the calendar with a reminder on the phone. But Jesus starts His answer with a warning.

cards.question: What's the first warning Jesus gives the disciples?

answers.text: Don't go back to the temple

cards.question: Jesus warns that many will come in His name claiming to be the Christ, but they will deceive only a few. True or false?

cards.text: Next, Jesus says the disciples will hear of wars and rumors of wars. That's a lot of news coming their way.

cards.question: When the disciples hear of wars and rumors of wars, how does Jesus tell them to react?

answers.text: Get out of the city fast

cards.question: Jesus says the wars must happen, but the ___ is still to come.

cards.text: And there's more. Nation will rise against nation and kingdom against kingdom, with famines and earthquakes in various places.

cards.question: Jesus sums up the wars, famines and earthquakes with one picture. What does He say they are the beginning of?

cards.text: The BEGINNING, friend. Not the finish line. Then Jesus tells the disciples they'll be handed over to be persecuted and killed.

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples they will be hated by all nations because of His name. True or false?

cards.text: At that time many will fall away, betray one another and hate one another. And many false prophets will arise and deceive many.

cards.question: Because wickedness multiplies, Jesus says the love of most will grow ___.

cards.text: Okay. That's a heavy list, friend. But then Jesus talks about the one who perseveres to the end.

cards.question: Jesus says the one who perseveres to the end will be ___.
Jesus says this gospel of the kingdom will be preached only in Israel, and then the end will come. True or false?

cards.text: In all the world, as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come. Pull up a seat, friend, because Jesus is still sitting on that mountain and He is NOT done talking.

findings.problem: Stop 1, card 1 quotes "Look at THIS one. No, no, look at THIS one!", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: "Every stone." "Thrown down." and "They point at the building, Jesus says it's coming DOWN, and I bet the rest of that walk got real quiet."

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: "They point at the building" uses the singular. The text says the disciples came to point out the temple's "buildings" (Matthew 24:1).

rule.text: Call things what the text calls them.

findings.problem: The right answer "When it will happen and what the sign will be" leaves out what the disciples ask the sign of: "Your coming and of the end of the age" (Matthew 24:3). No other card mentions it, so the baker never learns that the sermon answers a question about Jesus' coming and the end of the age. Card 5's retelling ("They want a date") doesn't add it either.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.

findings.problem: This story card has three sentences: "They want a date." "A day, a time, circled on the calendar with a reminder on the phone." and "But Jesus starts His answer with a warning."

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: "That's a lot of news coming their way" reads like a nice dad being pleasant. It isn't a real Papa Dorin reaction.

rule.text: If a line reads like a nice dad being pleasant, push it further.

findings.problem: No earlier card tells the baker the disciples asked about "the end of the age." Card 4's answer left it out. That makes "end" against "peace" or "rest" a guess at wording the baker hasn't seen, because "peace is still to come" makes just as much sense.

rule.text: The check: could a thoughtful baker who has only seen the earlier cards make a reasoned pick? If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question.

findings.problem: Apart from "And there's more," this card is a flat paraphrase of Matthew 24:7 with none of Papa Dorin's voice.

rule.text: Short, but not stripped down. A story card still has enough of Papa Dorin's voice and enough context that the moment makes sense.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.
